title: a11y Action Auto-Diff
desc: Auto-diffs parent node state before/after mutating a11y actions. File-edit format output. 1s retry on no-change then error-exit. Broker detection.
steps: FEATURE: reads parent window node list before and after mutating actions (invoke/type/click/toggle/expand/collapse/select/set-value/set-range)
FORMAT: < [role] removed-node  and  > [role] added-node per line -- matches wkappbot file edit diff style
NO-CHANGE: if diff empty wait 1s re-read re-diff. Still empty: [WARN] no state change after action + exit 1
BROKER: if [BLOCKER] appears in post not pre, marks line with <- NEW BROKERR
IMPL: A11yActions.ActionDiff.cs partial class -- SnapshotNodeLines() DiffAndPrint() TryGetWindowGrap()
